snippet.title: How to Start your Own AI Automation Agency in 2025
snippet.description:
Feeling stuck picking your AI automation niche? You’re not alone. I’ve been there. Staring at a blank screen. Wondering which industry to target. Overthinking every move.

But here’s the truth. Waiting for the “perfect” offer is like waiting for rain in the desert. It might never come. And while you wait, someone else is sending emails. Landing clients. Building their agency.

So what should you do? Simple.

* Pick three niches. Don’t overthink it. Just choose.
* Use AI tools like Apollo to pull lists of leads.
* Pay a few bucks. Get thousands of contacts.
* Drop them into your favorite automation tool-Make.com or n8n work great.
* Hit send.

That’s it. You can do all this in two hours. I once did it in less-while waiting for my coffee to brew.

Think of it like fishing. You don’t know which pond has the most fish until you cast your line. The more lines you cast, the better your odds.

And the best part? Every email you send teaches you something. You learn which industries reply. Which offers get ignored. Which tools save you the most time.

The good news? You don’t need to be perfect. You just need to start. Because in the world of AI automation, action beats analysis every single time.

So, ready to cast your line?
